statutory_act: LMPC Rules, 2011 read with Electronics and IT Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order & BIS Act, 2016

bis_crs_registration.description: BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) number 'R-XXXXXXXX' with 'Self Declaration - Conforming to IS ...' or standard ISI mark.
bis_crs_registration.statutory_citation: MeitY Compulsory Registration Order: Electronic products must declare valid BIS Registration (R-XXXXXXXX) and IS standard number.
bis_crs_registration.remedy: Immediate seizure of unregistered electronic goods under BIS Act and LMPC.

electrical_rating.description: Rated voltage (e.g. 220-240V AC), frequency (50Hz), and input/output power (Wattage/Amperes).
electrical_rating.statutory_citation: LMPC Rules & BIS: Rated electrical specifications shall be marked clearly on the product and carton.

model_number.description: Model number or identifier corresponding exactly to BIS test report and invoice.
model_number.statutory_citation: Rule 6(1)(b): Specific model designation of electrical/electronic commodity.
model_number.remedy: Notice for model mismatch / traceability failure.

ewaste_symbol.description: Symbol of crossed-out wheeled bin indicating product must not be disposed of with municipal waste.
ewaste_symbol.statutory_citation: E-Waste Management Rules 2022: Producers shall ensure that the symbol indicating electronic waste is printed on packaging.
